$comment: Golden cases of the guild war declare dialog (tools/check_nui_snapshots.py; P16 spec 5.10, 12): a modal on the scrim, the enemy guild's field empty (a field's text is never in the model), the second battle type chosen; hover-hint: RmlUi's pointer on that type's button (a point inside it in every look), its hint (the type's title and description lines, legacy's tooltip) shown; translucent: modern-dark and modern-light at 80% panel opacity over the synthetic backdrop. The foundation's 24-character limit is the field's only (guild-war-declare.foundation.fixture.json), which no frame shows; the member cap's and end score's fields (NOVA-90) show empty, as no field's text is in the model. Classic is legacy's 230 x 170 board, the fields on their slot bars, the small type buttons and the middle buttons; its art is in assets/ETC.
